mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, u.phone, u.target_school, u.target_score, u.exam_year, u.prep_stage, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, r.role_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.username = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, u.phone, u.target_school, u.target_score, u.exam_year, u.prep_stage, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, r.role_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, u.phone, u.target_school, u.target_score, u.exam_year, u.prep_stage, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, r.role_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE r.role_code = 'ROLE_USER' ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = 'ROLE_USER' AND DATE(u.created_at) = CURDATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, nickname, avatar, email, phone, target_school, target_score, exam_year, prep_stage, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{targetSchool}, #{targetScore}, #{examYear}, #{prepStage}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_id = VALUES(role_id)
